title: The runway has no single address
governingQuestion: What happens when a fashion week is coordinated centrally but staged across a city?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: New York makes time itself operational: calendar authority, dispersed venues, capture, broadcast, production labor, orders and memory must coordinate. This chapter follows staging: Atmosphere is engineered through temporary architecture, power, light, sound, seating, cueing, safety and teardown—then edited out of the effortless final image.
beats.onScreen: Then: The 2021 official schedule marked a return to in-person shows after two predominantly digital seasons and identified CFDA–IMG coordination.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The 2021 official schedule marked a return to in-person shows after two predominantly digital seasons and identified CFDA–IMG coordination. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The September 2026 schedule contains runway shows, presentations, appointments and digital premieres; it coordinates formats rather than naming one venue stack.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No public CFDA record reviewed specifies a single technical venue system for New York’s next season; supplier and room-level stacks remain reporting assignments.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger
